proposal.reason: Main change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are parsed/validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks in init/comm structures. Add enqueue because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream graph/uncaptured synchronization semantics (capture/mixing behavior) across strongstream, enqueue, and channel stream operations. Add device-topology because P2P channel-per-peer and peer-budget computation was substantively changed in topology path/channel logic (including maxP2pPeers and nChannelsPerNetPeer effects), not just mechanical call-site edits.
